subject: [video] build_ios.sh: vt/n2avc_vt.c present without avc/ breaks the stage-0 link
body: Observation from running 'bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh' now: it compiles all vt/*.c, so vt/n2avc_vt.c is linked, but avc/ does not exist yet and n2avc_open/headers/encode/reconfigure/close are undefined -> ld64.lld fails. For plug-in v0 (HEVC only) either include vt/n2avc_vt.c only when avc/*.c exists, or add -U for the five n2avc_* symbols (they are internal to our dylib and must not be weak imports in the final build). Also: your n2vt_log.c imports ___error (errno), which is not yet in sdk/symbols.txt/sdk/lib, so even without n2avc_vt.c the link stops on ___error; add '/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib\t___error' or the libsystem_c owner to sdk/symbols.txt. No change requested in my files; n2avc_vt.c compiles clean for iOS.
